note: ja simple and standard are bare synonyms (ぶし/武士), not child register or a real definition; zh standard repeats the word and is thin.

changes.def_ja_simple: むかしのにほんで、たたかうしごとをしていたひと。
changes.def_ja_standard: 武家に仕え、戦いを職分とした身分の人。
changes.def_zh_standard: 武士 —— 旧时日本以征战为职责的阶层

note: Definitions join two senses (the act of deciding, 'また、その内容'); reduce to the single sense 'a resolution adopted at a meeting'.

changes.def_ja_standard: 会議で議案について意思を決定すること。
changes.def_en_standard: resolution — a decision formally adopted at a meeting
changes.def_zh_standard: 决议 —— 会议正式通过的决定

note: en simple 'financial statement' does not match the standard gloss 'settlement'; align both to the JLPT sense (settlement of accounts).

changes.def_en_standard: settlement of accounts; closing — calculating income and expenses for a period

note: ja/en/zh standards join two senses (original shape; 'また' a word's base form). Reduce to original form; the example also used the base-form sense, so it is replaced.

changes.def_ja_standard: 変化する前の、もとの形。
changes.def_en_standard: original form — the shape before any change
changes.def_zh_standard: 原形 —— 发生变化之前的原本形状
changes.example_ja: かたちがかわり、げんけいをとどめていません。

note: ja standard is wrong and joins two statements: 検事 is a rank of 検察官, not an 'old name' for it. Rewritten as a single sense.

changes.def_ja_standard: 検察官の一つで、犯罪を捜査し裁判所に起訴する公務員。
